title: Indicator: indicator-bottom indicator-end (default) (daisyUI)
notes:
Indicators are used to place an element on the corner of another element.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/indicator/+page.md
